chars.DAD: DAD: an older man wearing a cream djellaba with thin brown stripes, a red fez hat, brown leather slippers.
chars.SON: SON: a young man wearing a brand-new navy blue suit, light blue shirt, no tie, shiny black shoes.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing an emerald green kaftan with a gold embroidered belt and a beige headscarf.
chars.LADY: LADY: a middle-aged woman, the girl's mother, wearing a lilac satin kaftan and a white headscarf, gold bracelets.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Moroccan salon in Casablanca with long blue sedari sofas and a brass tea tray, DAD abruptly stands up from the sofa with a stern closed face, waving his hand at SON to get up and leave; SON still sits holding a bouquet of roses, mouth open in confusion; LADY stands near the door, pale and frozen. Subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the same Moroccan salon, DAD briskly picks up the big bouquet of roses and a gold chocolate box from the low table, tucking them under his arm, while SON stands beside him staring at him in disbelief with raised palms. Subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon, LADY stands in the middle of the room, pale and stiff, eyes lowered, a spilled tea tray and glasses on the carpet at her feet; GIRL stands behind her looking confused and hurt, hand on her chest. Subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the open apartment door of a Moroccan building stairwell, DAD walks out first with the bouquet and chocolate box under his arm, determined; SON follows him but looks back over his shoulder toward the flat, lost and embarrassed. Subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On a Casablanca street at dusk next to a parked car, SON stands with one hand on his head, completely stunned, eyes wide as if he had just been hit on the head, comic dazed expression. Subject in the centre.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the back seat of a car at night, SON stares worriedly at his phone screen which glows on his face (screen seen from behind, no readable text), thumb hovering, anxious waiting expression. Subject in the centre.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan family living room with sedari sofas, DAD points firmly at the sofa telling SON to sit down; SON, still in his suit, slowly sits down looking nervous. Subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan family living room, DAD sits leaning toward SON, very serious, raising one finger as he speaks; SON sits facing him with a shocked, confused face. Warm lamp light. Subjects in the centre.
